title: Strategie Nationale de Developpement du Numerique en Cote d'Ivoire (SNNCI 2021-2025)
publisher: Ministere de l'Economie Numerique, des Telecommunications et de l'Innovation
why_not: Superseded as the localisation instrument by the SNGD 2030, which states the rule directly; the SNNCI only foresees a state datacentre and a future data and cloud strategy. Not fetched.

title: Politique d'hebergement des donnees dans le cloud
why_not: An operational hosting procedure that routes ministries to Microsoft Azure coupled to the eGOUV datacentre - it governs public hosting but does not require data to reside in Cote d'Ivoire. Not fetched.

title: Kalil Konate sur le site de construction du premier Data Center national a Anoumambo
publisher: Ministere de la Transition Numerique et de la Digitalisation
why_not: Out of window and superseded for this indicator by the 2025-12-09 site visit, which carries a later execution rate and a financing figure. Not fetched.

title: Le Ministre Kalil KONATE inaugure le Premier Data Center Tier III en Cote d'Ivoire
publisher: Ministere de la Transition Numerique et de la Digitalisation
why_not: Private colocation capacity, not an instrument imposing localisation, and out of window. Not fetched.

title: Inauguration d'un data center du groupe panafricain St Digital
publisher: Ministere de la Transition Numerique et de l'Innovation Technologique
why_not: A private facility's commissioning is infrastructure capacity, not a movement in localisation policy; staged instead under infra.store--off-site-backup-capacity.

title: Strategie Nationale de la Gouvernance des donnees en Cote d'Ivoire 2024-2030
publisher: Ministere de la Transition Numerique et de la Digitalisation
why_not: Carries the open-data principle - public data freely available on the open-data platform, updated at least quarterly - but the cap allows one baseline and the portal's own founding statement is the more specific instrument. The body is in the batch as the data-localisation baseline.

title: Plan d'action national de gouvernement ouvert 2024-2026
publisher: Open Government Partnership / Gouvernement de Cote d'Ivoire
why_not: A political commitment plan, not the open-data policy itself; its engagement 6 promotes an already-existing portal, and it predates the window. Not fetched; a sibling slice has staged this document.

title: Open Data (CI0024)
why_not: A 2018-2020 commitment record and IRM assessment - useful for the negative finding that no open-data act exists, but a third-party evaluation of a closed cycle rather than the standing instrument. Not fetched.

title: Licence
why_not: The reuse licence is an operational annex to the initiative page already staged as the baseline; one baseline per indicator. Not fetched.

title: Independent Reporting Mechanism Action Plan Review: Cote d'Ivoire 2024-2026
publisher: Open Government Partnership - Independent Reporting Mechanism
why_not: Fetched. Its open-data content is a single annex row rating Commitment 6 verifiable with modest potential; the review's substance is commitments 1, 2, 8 and 9 and it does not assess the open-data policy. The capture was also truncated at the fetch limit.

title: Semaine OGP 2026 ouverte
why_not: An open-government week rather than an open-data movement; nothing in the lead states a change to the policy or the portal. Not fetched; a sibling slice has staged this document.

title: Donnees - Portail officiel des donnees ouvertes
why_not: A live catalogue page with no establishable publication date - dataset arrivals are operational output, not a policy movement. Not fetched.

title: Instruction n 008-05-2015 regissant les conditions et modalites d'exercice des activites des emetteurs de monnaie electronique dans l'UMOA
why_not: The historic electronic-money instrument, superseded in practice by Instruction n 001-01-2024 on payment services; operative beats superseded. Not fetched.

title: Reglement n 15/2002/CM/UEMOA relatif aux systemes de paiement dans les Etats membres de l'UEMOA
why_not: The 2002 regional foundation for payment systems, two instruments back from the operative regime. Not fetched.

title: Lois - ANSSI Cote d'Ivoire
why_not: An index page of national laws, not an instrument; loi n 2013-546 on electronic transactions is already held in the base and is transversal rather than a payments regime. Not fetched.

title: Prolongation du delai de connexion a PI-SPI
why_not: An implementation adjustment to the same PI-SPI rollout rather than a distinct event, and a sibling slice has staged the underlying 2 April 2026 communique. Not fetched.

title: Ordonnance n 2024-950 du 30 octobre 2024 portant modification des articles 3 et 17 de l'ordonnance n 2017-500
publisher: Presidence de la Republique de Cote d'Ivoire
why_not: An amendment to two articles of the enacting ordinance, out of window as progress and weaker than the ordinance itself as baseline. Not fetched.

title: Loi portant ratification de l'ordonnance n 2017-500 du 02 aout 2017
why_not: The ratification law carries no visible number or promulgation date in the published file, so it could not be dated safely; the ordinance it ratifies is staged instead. Not fetched.

title: Communique du conseil des ministres du mercredi 12 juin 2024
publisher: Presidence de la Republique de Cote d'Ivoire
why_not: Out of window and institutional rather than legislative - it records the decrees dissolving the INS and creating ANStat, the FNDS and the CNStat. Not fetched.

title: Communique du conseil des ministres du mercredi 18 juin 2025
publisher: Presidence de la Republique de Cote d'Ivoire
why_not: The same sitting as the SGG communique staged as the baseline; two records of one event, and the SGG text is the government's own publication of record. Not fetched.

title: Agence Nationale de la Statistique
publisher: Ministere du Plan et du Developpement
why_not: An institutional page describing ANStat under decret n 2024-372 - the agency, not the statistics law the indicator asks about. Not fetched.

title: Country Profile of Cote d'Ivoire
why_not: Historical corroboration of the 1991 and 1996 decrees creating and transforming the INS; superseded by the 2013 and 2020 laws and the 2024 reorganisation. Not fetched.

title: Strategie nationale de developpement de la Statistique 2026-2030 : le rapport Vision et strategies adopte
publisher: Plateforme officielle du bilan du Gouvernement / CICG
why_not: Six days after the diagnostic validation already staged and part of the same workshop sequence; two reports of one process step rather than a distinct event. Not fetched.

title: le conseil des ministres du 22-12-2021
publisher: Mission permanente de la Cote d'Ivoire aupres des Nations Unies
why_not: A dated record of the adoption of decret 2021-913 and the two companion frameworks, but the decree itself is already held in the base - a restatement, not the instrument. Not fetched.

title: DECRET N 2021-913 du 22/12/2021, portant adoption du referentiel general d'interoperabilite des systemes d'information
why_not: A bibliographic notice confirming Journal officiel publication, not the text; the decree is already held. Not fetched.

title: Measuring digital development: ICT price trends 2024
why_not: Published 26 May 2025 on 2024 data, so out of the progress window, and a publication landing page rather than the Ivorian series; the national prix moyens constates are the closer measure for this indicator. Not fetched.

title: Indices tarifaires
why_not: The regulator's tariff observatory landing page carries no dated series in its indexed content; the economy ministry page republishes the same ARTCI figures with the series intact. Not fetched.

title: 2021 Affordability Report
why_not: A 2021 drivers index measuring the policy environment, not a price or a price-to-income ratio, and five years stale. Not fetched.

title: ICT prices
why_not: An undated statistics landing page whose Ivorian values sit in downloadable files rather than the page; no publication date could be established and no country figure is on the page. Not fetched.

title: Annexe fiscale 2026
why_not: Changes the allocation of the existing 5 per cent telecom and mobile-money levy without changing its rate or base, so it is not a movement in what users pay. Not fetched.

title: Kalil Konate sur le site de construction du premier Data Center national a Anoumambo
publisher: Ministere de la Transition Numerique et de la Digitalisation
why_not: Out of window and superseded by the launch statement staged as the baseline, which carries the storage, rack and power specification this one omits. Not fetched.

title: Le Ministre Kalil KONATE inaugure le Premier Data Center Tier III en Cote d'Ivoire
publisher: Ministere de la Transition Numerique et de la Digitalisation
why_not: The RAXIO CIV1 inauguration is out of window and already reflected in the report's infra.store rows. Not fetched.

title: Transition numerique : La Cote d'Ivoire abritera le plus grand Data Center d'Afrique de l'Ouest
why_not: Corroborates the same December 2023 groundbreaking as the staged baseline and carries a storage figure two orders of magnitude apart from the ministry's - a hundredfold discrepancy left unresolved rather than staged. Not fetched.

title: Cote d'Ivoire - Raxio Group
why_not: An operator's own undated facility page for a private colocation site, not the state's off-site backup capacity. Not fetched.

title: ST DIGITAL et OVHcloud s'allient pour batir un Cloud 100 pour cent africain, souverain et de confiance
why_not: A vendor's commercial partnership announcement rather than a state hosting arrangement, and the same operator's facility is already the first progress item; two items on one operator would waste the cap. Not fetched.

title: RAPPORT D'ACTIVITES 2024
why_not: The regulator's newest annual report is the more authoritative anchor but its landing page exposes no reliability table, and the economy ministry page carries the TMC series through 2024 in text. Not fetched; worth a targeted acquire if the PDF is reachable.

title: RAPPORT D'ACTIVITES 2022 et Perspectives 2023
why_not: Carries TMC, energie non distribuee and availability for 2022, but the staged page carries the same series two years further forward; most recent authoritative publication wins. Not fetched.

title: Performances
why_not: Undated and its observed series stops at 2020; its 2030 and 2021 figures are projections that must not be read as measurements. Not fetched.

title: Le Concessionnaire
why_not: The regulator's historical TMC series stops at 2018 and the page is undated. Not fetched.

title: Coupures actuelles d'electricite : un programme d'urgence, d'un cout d'environ 32 milliards FCFA, est en train d'etre execute pour y mettre un terme
why_not: A republication of the government spokesman's press point; prefer the issuing body, and the only official route found - a gouv.ci flash line - is an undated headline stub. Not fetched.

title: Cote d'Ivoire : Communique CIE - Renforcement du reseau electrique d'Abidjan Sud
why_not: Syndication of a utility communique that does not appear on cie.ci; primary beats syndication and the issuing body's own copy could not be located. Not fetched.

title: Pacte national energie pour la Republique de Cote d'Ivoire
publisher: Republique de Cote d'Ivoire / World Bank
why_not: January 2025 and its series stops at 2023, where the staged economy ministry page runs to 2024; it also predates the window as progress. Not fetched.

title: Electrif Rural
why_not: The regulator's locality count is undated and stops at 2020, and it publishes no coverage rate. Not fetched.

title: PRONER - Programme National d'Electrification Rurale
why_not: An undated institutional programme page whose figures cover 2019-2020; the staged series carries PRONER's 2017-2024 outturn. Not fetched.

title: PEPT - Programme Electricite Pour Tous
why_not: An undated institutional page on the connection subsidy mechanism, with a 2014-2018 figure the staged series supersedes at 2,278,150 connections to 2024. Not fetched.

title: Cote d'Ivoire Digital Acceleration Project (P180059) - Project Information Document
why_not: An external appraisal of the capacity rather than the state's own statement of what its ICT function is mandated to do, and its 2023 assessment predates the PADCI ratification staged as the progress item. Not fetched.

title: Nos missions - ANSSI Cote d'Ivoire
why_not: The cyber agency is a specialised security capability, not the function that builds, runs and maintains government applications; the report already holds its creation and its work. Not fetched.

title: E-GOUVERNEMENT ET SIMPLIFICATION DES PROCEDURES ADMINISTRATIVES
why_not: A December 2024 conference record of services delivered rather than of the capacity that maintains them, and out of the progress window. Not fetched.

title: Lancement officiel de la Plateforme d'Interoperabilite de l'Administration
publisher: Ministere de la Transition Numerique et de l'Innovation Technologique
why_not: A platform launch, and its capacity content is a transfer of competences mentioned only in a companion note; staged instead under the two interoperability indicators it answers directly. The body is in the batch.

title: LOI DE FINANCES N 2024-1109 DU 18 DECEMBRE 2024 PORTANT BUDGET DE L'ETAT POUR L'ANNEE 2025, Annexe 1 : Annexe fiscale
publisher: Ministere des Finances et du Budget
why_not: Fetched, but the capture truncated well before the taxpayer-registration provision; the body in hand carries the general presentation note and unrelated measures only, so a note claiming it establishes the fichier des contribuables would not be supported by its own text. The DGI's own commentary page was staged instead.

title: Rapport d'analyse de l'Annuaire statistique d'etat civil, edition 2023
publisher: Ministere de l'Interieur et de la Securite
why_not: Fetched. It carries the figures the indicator most wants, 105 civil-registration circonscriptions equipped with Cityweb in 2023 of which 97 transmitting, against 674 principal centres comprising 201 communes and 473 sous-prefectures, but the PDF's font encoding defeats text extraction, every accented character coming out as a replacement character, so a verbatim capture would be corrupt. Recorded here rather than staged; worth a refetch by another route if the cap is widened.

title: Cote d'Ivoire-AIP/ La police scientifique de la gendarmerie renforcee par un don d'equipements de pointe de l'UE
why_not: Fetched and read in full. The handover of biometric capture and crime-scene equipment under the AFIS/SIPAO project took place at the Commandement superieur de la Gendarmerie nationale at Abidjan Plateau and the body names no unit, brigade or commissariat outside the capital; the missions to the north and centre reported elsewhere are not in this text. Selecting it would have put a national forensic-capability step under an indicator about digital capture at rural stations. Conservative option taken: not staged, and the indicator carries a baseline and no progress.

title: Ministere de l'Enseignement Superieur et de la Recherche Scientifique :: Recherche Scientifique
publisher: Ministere de l'Enseignement Superieur et de la Recherche Scientifique
why_not: Strong francophone primary and the official enumeration of Ivorian university research centres, but it describes the national research architecture generally and names no digital-transformation mandate; the baseline slot went to the unit whose research programme is explicitly digital. Held in case the frame later wants the architecture rather than the department.

title: Fonds pour l'Insertion Professionnelle des Personnes en Situation de Handicap (FIPPSH)
publisher: Ministere de l'Emploi et de la Protection Sociale et de la Formation Professionnelle
why_not: A genuine instrument with its enabling decree 2023-88 of 15 February 2023, the employment quota, the employer contribution formula and COTOREP certification - but it governs access to employment, not access to services, and carries nothing digital. Excluded by the one-baseline cap, not on quality.

title: EU trade relations with West Africa
publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Trade and Economic Security
why_not: Undated standing overview page carrying the SIFA launch as one section among many; published could not be established from it. The Commission's own dated news article of 17 July 2026 covers the same event and was staged instead.
